why: Check logs a different message after the burst, so the final repeat count prints on both builds; the no-follow-up case is never tested.
Checks font-size, selection and style-paste formatting of bound text; undo after selecting bound text is never tested or named.
Check 1 activates the eraser with E and presses Escape expecting the previous tool back, the exact trigger; the risk is not framed.
Custom-swatch checks including the z shortcut, but nothing reaches the missing gallery parent that throws.
Says canvas updates may land later under frame throttling, but checks only rapid drags and viewport changes after settling; no window resize.
Check 1 follows a link with & in the query and expects both parameters, which fails when & is stored as &; names the new ampersand escaping.
Checks focus-point (connection point) dragging only; never drags the endpoint of an arrow bound inside a shape.
Notes frame overlap now uses element bounds, but no check drags an element that fully contains a frame.
Uncertainty names the lookup with an undefined embed value, but the check only asks that the resource is still returned, which holds with the extra key.
Check 1 starts the server with a file-path database and reads a record, the exact trigger; explanation is generic.
Default-option and header-merge checks only; nothing depends on the receiver fetch is called with.
Check 1 uses application/vnd.api+json but expects binary data, the buggy result; it does name the +json change.
Flags the dotfile change but check 1 expects .env to have extension .env, which is the buggy result; no .., . or ..foo cases.
withoutBase checks cover a path remainder and an exact match, never a remainder that starts with a query.
